_comment: Rest spots (0.4.0). pos is the seat in world pixels, or cell in a cave (column, row). view points the camera's slow drift toward the view. Positions were chosen in open ground that the generated scenery already leaves free, so no scenery or object id changes.

spots.name: Sunset Hill
spots.text: A soft green rise where the evening light stays a little longer.

spots.name: The Village Bench
spots.text: A bench at the edge of the village. You can hear the campfire from here.

spots.name: Creekside Log
spots.text: An old log beside the water. The creek talks quietly to itself.

spots.name: Waterfall View
spots.text: A flat stone with a view toward the falls. The sound of water fills everything.

spots.name: Firefly Bench
spots.text: A mossy bench under the glowcaps. At night, the fireflies come close.

spots.name: Lookout Stump
spots.text: A wide stump below the old lookout tower. The pines hush the wind.

spots.name: Moonlit Bench
spots.text: A pale stone bench in the sanctuary. The stars feel very near here.

spots.name: Cliff Edge
spots.text: A grassy cliff edge above the sea. The waves arrive slowly, one by one.

spots.name: Driftwood Seat
spots.text: A smooth piece of driftwood on the beach, warm from the sun.

spots.name: Aurora Ridge
spots.text: A sheltered ridge under the open sky. On some nights, the aurora dances above.

spots.name: Isle Rock
spots.text: A sun-warmed rock on the little isle. Nothing to do here but listen.

spots.name: Crystal Pool
spots.text: A still pool in the grotto. The crystals hum a single, patient note.
